sourceBindings.text: A report may state a nutrient in parts per million (ppm), or provide a Low, Medium/Optimum or High class. Ppm means one part in a million parts on the stated mass or volume basis. For a mass-of-soil result, 1 ppm can be expressed as 1 mg/kg; a solution result might be mg/L. Do not convert one into the other without the laboratory's reporting basis and calculation.

units.delivery: Explain calmly and naturally to agricultural vocational learners in clear English. Read only the supplied connected passage with natural pauses. Preserve all negations, conditions, scene-safety restrictions and limits of training. Do not add medical advice, diagnoses, character voices, an introduction, music or an extra summary.
